dsh.customCli.title: Custom dsh base
dsh.customCli.desc: Use a dsh base from a directory you specify (your own build or a modified fork). Two layouts are recognized: package source root (with apps/cli/lib/bin.js) / npm install directory.
dsh.customCli.placeholder: Enter or choose a dsh directory…
dsh.customCli.appliedWithPending: ✓ Active — version {{version}} · {{count}} running session(s) marked for restart
dsh.customCli.overrideHint: A custom base is active; installs below only write to the data root. Clear the custom directory to switch back.
dsh.extRestartHint: Plugin enable/disable changes take effect after restarting the dsh session process (next session or reopen the current one).
dsh.title: DSH kernel version management
dsh.desc: Maintains only ~/.my-harness-desktop/dsh. Pick a version to install (newer = upgrade, older = downgrade); the desktop doesn't touch PATH's dsh.
dshModels.title: DSH model config
dshModels.desc: dsh's provider = LLM adapter route (llm-deepseek's deepseek-official + llm-pi-ai's providers dictionary). Edit each route's connection facts (apiKeyEnv/api/baseURL) and models (id/name/contextWindow/maxTokens). Keys are entered per provider and injected into their respective apiKeyEnv at spawn.
dshModels.apiKeyDesc: The key literal is stored on the desktop per provider and injected as the {{env}} environment variable at spawn. It is not written into settings.yaml/cordis.yml.
dshModels.name: name
dshModels.importDesc: Paste JSON (single or array of {provider, apiKeyEnv?, displayName?, api?, baseURL?, models}): existing provider is overwritten, otherwise appended.
dshModels.importInvalid: Invalid JSON or wrong shape (expected {provider, models:[]})
dshExt.title: DSH Extensions
dshExt.desc: Cordis plugin tree (npm packages @deepseek-ai/dsh-*), declared in cordis.yml. Disable = remove from cordis.yml, enable = restore.
dsh.appliedWithPending: ✓ Active — version {{version}} · {{count}} running session(s) marked for restart
dshExt.pendingRestart: session(s) need reload to apply changes
dsh.fieldDescs.ui-onboarding.welcomeNoti: Shown welcome-notice version (auto-managed; usually no need to edit)
dsh.configDesc: Edit dsh's native config (non-model sections of ~/.dsh/settings.yaml; model sections live in the DSH Models tab).
